comment.body: Thanks for clarifying that this is recovery from a damaged uninstall. The same failure is already tracked in #34299: the installer reports `0x81f40001` and falsely detects an all-users PowerToys installation even though PowerToys is not available normally. Please continue the recovery discussion there and add the relevant installer log from this machine so the remaining Windows Installer state can be compared in one place. Closing this report as a duplicate of #34299.
